segs.text: This week, an Ethereum researcher asked the entire crypto industry to prepare for something called... bunker mode.
parts: This week, an Ethereum researcher asked the entire crypto industry to prepare for something called...

segs.text: The threat? Not quantum computers. A.I.
Every crypto wallet is protected by a hard maths problem.
parts: Every crypto wallet is protected by a hard maths problem.

segs.text: Justin Drake warns that A.I. could find a shortcut through it. In the worst case, in months, not years.
parts: Justin Drake warns that A.I. could find a shortcut through it.
In the worst case, in months, not years.

segs.text: Vitalik Buterin agrees the risk is real. Even some quantum-resistant designs could take a hit.
parts: Vitalik Buterin agrees the risk is real.
Even some quantum-resistant designs could take a hit.

segs.text: To be clear: no such attack has been shown yet.
parts: no such attack has been shown yet.

segs.text: The advice? Keep your public key off-chain where you can. And don't rush. Buterin says he's lost more money in botched migrations than in all hacks combined.
parts: Keep your public key off-chain where you can.
Buterin says he's lost more money in botched migrations than in all hacks combined.

segs.text: The lesson for anyone building a blockchain: design for adversaries that don't exist yet.
